newsitem.title: UK: CU shares fall after Merrill downgrade.
newsitem.headline: CU shares fall after Merrill downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc fell on Tuesday after Merrill Lynch downgraded its recommendation on the company to "hold" from "buy."
"We feel the share price relative to the NAV (net asset value) is a bit overvalued for 1997," said Steven Bird, insurance analyst at Merrill Lynch.
Shares in CU closed down 12p at 713-1/2p.
"We like the stock for the long run. We think they've invested well to build up their overseas life (insurance) operations. But we think it's a bit expensive in the short term," Bird said.
He said the downgrade did not reflect Merrill's forecast for CU's business figures, due on Wednesday, which he thought would be in line with market expectations.
